Recorded claim:
Prefer lower camel case for new IDs addressed by Thunderbird UI scripts in these components. D213166 explicitly changed supernova-logo to codenameLogo and made the name independent of the release. The same ID survives the newer meadow asset. Account colors use serverColor and the address-book Import button uses booksPaneImport. Name the stable role, and change the asset or localized label separately. This evidence supports a new-ID convention; legacy dashed IDs and class names have other local families and do not require a blanket rename.

Provenance: detailed-batch-288-317. Original evidence IDs: 3c19941b957304a11e39e6c50690008ddcad11a3fe8ade4f95b0fd73d7bcb5ba, 1af2f0697af5bf2d17f1756faf0fcfc3a80cbb71cfe361f4d84d95d7891e648d, ca5b8af5fd95e218c6465ab3017e62ba5fc977794c377a4edd8775fcc14277d6.

title: Recorded lesson: Use lower camel case for new script-addressed UI IDs and stable role names
